    Description
    EventSerialiser
    Turns a session and its events into text in some output format.
    ExportService
    Runs every report exporter for a session.
    JsonEventSerialiser
    Writes a session as a JSON document with three parts: session (details and times), summary (compile counts and timing) and events (every event in time order, each with an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp).
    JsonReportExporter
    Saves a session as a .json file, using any EventSerialiser to produce the text.
    PdfReportExporter
    Saves a session as a .pdf report, using PdfReportMaker.
    PdfReportMaker
    Draws a ReportData as a PDF report using Apache PDFBox ReportData.
    RecordedSession
    A finished ession: its details plus the events recorded during it.
    ReportData
    Works out everything the PDF report shows.
    ReportExporter
    ReportExporter.export(SessionInfo, List, File) fixes the steps for saving a report (work out the file name, then write the file), and each subclass supplies only the format-specific parts: ReportExporter.extension() and ReportExporter.write(SessionInfo, List, File).
    SessionInfo
    The details that identify one coding session: who, which project, and when.
    SessionRecorder
    Observer that keeps the events for the current session only.
    SessionStatistics
    Calculates the summary numbers for a session from its events: event count, successful and failed compilations, and the average time between compiles.
